title: Concise decline
body: Thanks for reaching out and for sharing the context. I am not able to support this referral request, so I need to decline. I wish you well with the role.

title: Limited capacity
body: Thanks for reaching out. I do not have capacity to review referral requests right now, so I need to decline. I appreciate you thinking of me and wish you well with the role.

title: Not comfortable referring
body: Thanks for the thoughtful request. I am not comfortable supporting a referral in this case, so I need to decline. I appreciate your understanding and wish you the best.

title: Not enough direct context
body: Thanks for sharing this. I am not able to speak to your work closely enough to support a referral, so I need to decline. I appreciate the thoughtful request and wish you the best.

title: Outside review scope
body: Thanks for reaching out. This role is outside the areas I can review responsibly, so I am going to decline. I hope you find someone with more relevant context.

title: Policy or conflict
body: Thanks for the request. I cannot participate because of a policy or conflict consideration, so I need to decline. I am not able to provide additional detail, but I wish you well.

title: Request more information
body: Thanks for reaching out. Before I decide whether I can help, could you share the official job link or ID, a brief explanation of your fit for the role, and one or two examples of relevant work? Please leave out sensitive personal information.
